text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: A blank canvas of a future.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"There is no 'after this' for me. Because 
'now' is all I had. This was the only 
place I had."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"For me... There was no other choice but 
to win the Sprinters Stakes—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Is that truly so?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"—The Sprinters Stakes. A lightning-fast 
1,200m turf sprint at autumn Nakayama, 
where they clash for the title of 'The 
Fastest.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
A race most fitting to prove the nobility 
of blood, or to earn the glory worthy of 
repaying a great debt of gratitude...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That's right. That's why I... I 
absolutely had to win...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes is the race that 
determines the fastest in autumn."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Did you not foresee this? Did you not have 
the slightest inkling? ...Or perhaps, that 
too is a calling of the soul.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, Miracle-san. There certainly is a 
"future" ahead.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"March, swirling with cherry blossoms. 
Chukyo Turf, 1200m. On the grand stage of 
the GⅠ race, the pinnacle of the series, 
they compete for the crown of the spring 
sprint king—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: The Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I believe you are all well aware of the 
race known as the Takamatsunomiya Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the mansion's entrance hall. Facing 
the gathered press, Daiichi Ruby spoke in 
a calm, yet solemn tone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I somehow made it to the press conference 
in time... I managed to slide in just as 
the doors were about to close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I was so utterly drenched in 
sweat and tattered that they almost threw 
me out immediately, but――

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
They are a guest of mine. ...Please, step 
inside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Daiichi Ruby, who had come to 
my rescue, I was guided to a seat in the 
hall.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I helped K.S.Miracle sit down while 
supporting her, but she still hasn't woken 
up... The press conference continues.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen is a race 
steeped in noble history. My grandmother 
once claimed victory here, making her name 
as the great restorer of our 'Noble 
Clan.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: However, since then, times have changed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: The significance of the race has changed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Not merely vying for the prestigious cup, 
but making this a historic, commemorative 
race."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The very root of strength in racing. 
Competing in pure, unadulterated speed 
over a lightning-fast six furlongs.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Times change, meanings shift, and that 
stage—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It's become our race.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Next spring, I will run in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To prove the nobility of the blood running 
through my veins, I shall show you I can 
conquer both the Autumn and Spring 
showdowns for the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
And—all to make that honor shine even 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I, Daiichi Ruby, request that K.S. Miracle 
enter the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...K.S. Miracle is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still not... waking up—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen"...? "The 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen"............

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, that's... yeah, you're right. The 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen... is indeed like 
that, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Still, there really is no "future" for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My body... it's probably at its limit. I'm 
sure I've used up all the treasure I was 
given. I can't pull off a miraculous run 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"My peak was 'now.' Waiting until next 
spring... my speed, my body, neither could 
ever last that long—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ? Ruby,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Smack!!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Ah...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (My cheek... it hurts.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I would appreciate it if you refrained 
from such rude remarks.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: You are...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...You were my light.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ngh...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
At a time when I could see neither a 
future nor hope, your running, your speed, 
your very way of being illuminated my 
path.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"You are my light. To me... you were a 
miracle."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thus did passion awaken within my chest, 
and that crimson brilliance continues to 
burn within me to this day.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
How could there ever be an end... a limit 
to your brilliance?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To say that your future is a blank 
slate... How could I ever let such a thing 
happen?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Live up to that name and embody a 
"miracle," KS Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...And together, let us compete.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"On the future stage that will decide who 
is truly the fastest. ...Together!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Shattered glass begins to tremble"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Gathering up the pieces crushed into dust 
Were gentle hands, Hands that were 
forever, ever so warm."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Supported by the iron earth Embraced by 
the showering sunlight Guided by the 
strong winds blowing through"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "‘Touch the bright, crimson stone.’"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Broken wings spread wide A broken heart 
turns toward the sky"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Just once more.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Just once more,

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: “—One more time!!”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Just... one more time.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I can run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyelashes flutter, and her blue eyes 
peek out slightly. A thoroughly raspy 
voice reaches my ears nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I support her body as she slowly rises 
despite stumbling—and lead her away.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Me too. ...In the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I want to run. ...I am going to run, 
Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Very well, we shall proceed with that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the press conference, Daiichi Ruby's 
family provided a car. The effects of that 
accident seemed to have subsided, and we 
reached the hospital in no time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the journey, both of them tended to 
fall silent. It felt as though there was 
far too much they needed to say to one 
another, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, right now, above all 
else. There was something they both wanted 
to talk about.
choice_data_list: Shall we talk about "what comes next"?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For next spring's Takamatsunomiya Kinen... 
I want to train hard... once more.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become way stronger and way 
faster than I am 'now'."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I want a do-over. Starting with taking 
on graded races.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Starting from the Swan Stakes... I want 
to begin my future once more."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sorry. ...But I won't push 
myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Slow and steady, without rushing. But with 
all my might. I want to catch up to 
everyone ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Could you... help me make some 
adjustments, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She really is an incorrigible hard worker. 
With a wry smile—and full of 
determination, she slaps both hands 
against her knees.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Outside the window, a little bird took 
flight. K.S.Miracle narrowed her eyes 
against the bright sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most of the pages are still blank. Let us 
draw them. No matter what color the future 
takes, we will face it together from now 
on.
